notes.title: Dawn of Ages, Update 2.3.3
notes.content: [h3]The soldiers within the conflict have plundered a great deal from our enemies. of those a grand Scimitar, and flawless shield stand above all. The king has ordered them studied, so we may create our own, and we have succeeded. Please see the research notes below.[/h3][h1]Content[/h1][list][*][p]New Mythic-Perks[/p][list][*][p]Mythic Scimitar Perk: Reckless Swing[/p][list][*][p]A critical strike increases Area Chance by 100% for 1 attack. 5s Cooldown[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/8e6e83143276af1daf3f0418c8eefd04f8446882.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mythic Kite Shield Perk: Deflect[/p][list][*][p]A Successful Melee block returns 100% of the damage back to the attacker. (reduced by armor.)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]                                                  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/14a6dacc382ea5b6897e9e6b201b2ed2875776ac.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]We have added clan levels 14 and 15.[/p][list][*][p]We have added Clan Bosses 17 and 18.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1][b]Balancing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Mythic Items count now as 2 rarities higher within the game data, than legendaries.[/p][list][*][p]This results in higher damage/armor values[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Weapon Research Changes[/p][list][*][p]Blunt Weapons: We have added a Damage Increase of 20 on top of the 20 Minimum damage increase.[/p][/*][*][p]Slash Weapons: We have reduced Crit Damage from 10/20/30/40/50 to 4/8/12/16/20% (The crit Chance increase remains the same)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Perks with a Stack Limit above 1 will now stack correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Anglo Saxon Skill Tree.[/p][list][*][p]The Robin’s Flight Skill now also buffs throw range.[/p][/*][*][p]The Momentum Skill now also buffs throw damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have added the missing Collect All Button to the inbox for PC versions.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Known Issues[/h1][list][*][p]The Power value of mythic items currently presents as lower than the actual value their damage and armor values supply.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dawn of Ages 2.3.1
notes.content: [h1][i]Content[/i][/h1][p]The Tides of war rise once more, as Saladin renews his marches upon the west, the people tremble in fear. Some have even fled fearing a repeat of the Genghis invasion, or the El Cid invasion, or the other Saladin invasion. One thing is certain, our people are in great peril, and we are in need of warriors capable of putting an end to this vicious cycle.[/p][h2]Saladin event[/h2][list][*][p]The Saladin Event Returns, better than ever.[/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/f7849001d310c5ce85e0c4db35cc3e95c1a781b4.png"][/img][b]Balancing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Holy Lance: We have increased the Holy Lance’s entourage from -3 to -2. (They have 1 more unit now.)[/p][/*][*][p]Damage falloff for the Handgonne has been reduced from 50% to 40%, this means the minimum splash damage is 60%, up from 50%. (This is a buff)[/p][/*][*][p]Saladin Sandstorm: Now applies +100% Evasion to Saladin during the Sandstorm[/p][/*][*][p]Saladin: We have increased Saladin’s base evasion by a factor of 1.81 (at max level, base evasion goes from 55 → 100)[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug [b]Fixing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing the negotiation Clan Research to not work.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed several performance issues with Battle Passes.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed skins in the skin merging selection - now only a single skin type can be select in a melting or merging function.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed the research donation target initially set being cleared.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed the resource display in the Refinery.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed the skip level animation on the skip by gems function.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed Battle pass skip costs..[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed the shop rewards layout.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Clan City update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/340a3aa30027ddfcdf960c2b1c4f27a8125ffd16.png"][/img][/p][h1]Patchnotes 2.2.0[/h1][h3]The Clans have united in a Grand City, a truce has been called so leaders may unite and convene. This grand occasion marks the first step towards unity under the Kings Banner, though not all is well. Conflict already stirs as the far reaching Clans vie for influence and power within the castle. Though peace is assured for now, under threat of the realms wrath, the people are already aware the war is looming. For when the opportunity for power and gain arise, it is often in the best interest of the strong to remove their opposition. The individual Cities are already preparing for war, now all must choose a side, or be destroyed as a consequence.[/h3][h1][b][u]Content[/u][/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b][i]Clan City[/i][/b][/h2][p]The Clan City is a centralized hub for all clan activities. It replaces the previous Clan Hall UI. Similar to a player's city, the Clan City consists of multiple specialized buildings that each represent different systems and unlock exclusive clan features.[/p][list][*][p]Key buildings include:[/p][list][*][p]Clan Headquarters: This is the central building, which controls other building levels within the Clan City.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/1c7696428afd58ea0a6374470d96c6f96d3f7c45.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]University: This building unlocks new research and technologies, it also increases the maximum member count for your clan, and provides buffs.[/p][/*][/list][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/f747400936236bdb317f20c43709713efcf6556d.png"][/img][/h2][list][*][p]Clan Market: This building is a clan exclusive shop with offers shared between you and the clan members.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Upgrading Clan Buildings requires clan member donations.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/10f76fa9673338e05b79e4341cc402c8738470ab.png"][/img][/h2][p][/p][/*][*][p]All clan members are able to contribute resources towards their respective clan cities.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaders and co-leaders are able to mark buildings as a priority to direct members.[/p][/*][*][p]Personalization options include clan banners, flags, and customizable elements[/p][/*][/list][h2][b][i]New Weapon: Trident de Montserrat[/i][/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/6911cf6f2da0fd0015035ea8e5ecce0acee9b36e.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The Trident de Montserrat is a unique thrust offhand weapon, based on the historical trident design with connections to Vincenzo I Gonzaga.[/p][list][*][p][b]Weapon Type:[/b] Unique Thrust off-hand Weapon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Epoch:[/b] 5.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Unique Perk: Cold Blood[/p][list][*][p]Cold Blood: After a successful parry, the enemy's attack speed is reduced by 80% and resistance by 30% for 5 seconds. 5 seconds cooldown.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/87b90f9f1af2b4f2d565a9c2a08cd3041198205d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Item Donations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The ability to perform item donations to your Clan can now be researched via clan research.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Changes[/h1][list][*][p]We have changed the icon for “Riposte”.[/p][list][*][p]Old Icon:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/c4d056ec6e54f03eda95fe8eae182d709cdfb9f7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]New Icon:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/cf820b179db5a409583a3d3bbbac030968165772.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have Changed how the Calibration Perk operates.[/p][list][*][p]Old: [i]"A successful hit has a chance to increase precision for 2.5 seconds. 3s Cooldown."[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New: “A successful hit has a guaranteed chance to increase precision for the next attack.”[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have added a confirmation popup before kicking a clan member.[/p][/*][*][p]We have decreased the number of Clan members capacity by 2. This should not affect clans with higher capacity and the capacity can be increased via research.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Shop Clan Rewards Preview[/h3][list][*][p]We have improved the display for items given to your clan when purchasing a clan offer within the shop.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/90932541a7507ac80d6c322d8d72dd98f8ebd744.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Profile Page Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We have added a Fandom Button, linking to our Wiki within the Player Profile Screen.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Balancing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]The Parried Perk is now triggered only against melee weapons and not against ranged weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]We have increased the duration of the Concussion Perk from 2.5 to 3.5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]We have increased the difficulty of the final 4 clan bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]We have adjusted clan resource requests to fit the new clan city design and to be more varied.[/p][list][*][p]Increased yields and rewards for epoch 3+[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the quest to fulfill requests from 3 to 2 per day.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have heavily adjusted the Clan Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]We have lowered Siege Defense Coin Rewards from 200/400/600/800 to 200/300/400/500.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added El Cid to T3 Daily Legendary Battles.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added El Cid, Genghis and Saladin to T4 Daily Legendary Battles.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added El Cid, Genghis and Saladin to T5 Daily Legendary Battles.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixing[/h1][list][*][p]We have fixed an error where merging Tacticards can lead to connection errors.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing players to be stuck in a loading screen, when in a clan chat with members who have profile icons only available in a higher version.[/p][/*][*][p]We have improved the resolution of several icons and visuals from the game. This was particularly noticeable on Tablets.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added the Mace, Coat of Plates and Smith Garment to loot.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue allowing Crossbows, Arbalests and Chu-Ko-Nu to be affected by Bow buffs, they no longer are.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing Tacticard auto select to only select 2 Tacticards in maps where 3 were available.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue preventing the Fog Tacticard Synergy from taking effect when paired with Blinding Sun.[/p][/*][*][p]We have corrected an error with the Hoko Yari, previously it had gained an unintended stat boost when it hit 5.0. This has been corrected for all past and current instances of the item.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing some Tacticards to show no Synergy Effect. If conditions were met, the effect was still applied.[/p][/*][*][p]We have corrected the number of Selectable Tacticards, within event and raid battles.[/p][/*][*][p]We have corrected an issue causing the Tacticard Upgrade button to disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added a minimum Character Limit to player names.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dawn of Ages 2.0.4
notes.content: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/340a3aa30027ddfcdf960c2b1c4f27a8125ffd16.png"][/img][/h2][h3][b]The inventions of new have inspired the people to begin examining their own tools of trade, making improvements upon them to better serve their purposes and need. Upon this era innovation has struck the realm, with new devices, concepts, and methods arising in all reaches. Many weapons of old have now been improved upon and spread throughout, with new weapons and combat strategy following quickly behind. Updates to the Royal Armory follow:[/b][/h3][p][/p][h1][b]Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Offhand Weapons[/b][/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/2698c9f12897aa2dc674cab4a044c4e6cc565187.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Offhand Weapon: Stiletto[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/f0491ab78154faf1f1efaba2530a577f102353b5.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The Stiletto has a low chance to Parry while held.[/p][list][*][p]X% chance to negate melee damage.[/p][list][*][p]Parry grants increased armor piercing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Guaranteed Perk “Life Ender”: The wielder deals extra damage when the enemy is below 50% health.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Offhand Weapon: Javelin[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/92bc0c83daeae8e69806dcffb370895e5dc0d177.png"][/img][/h3][list][*][p]The Javelin is a ranged weapon thrown at the beginning of the battle.[/p][list][*][p]New ranged stats have been added to accommodate this and future items.[/p][list][*][p]Projectiles: 2[/p][list][*][p]After throwing both Javelins, the unit will switch to their main attack weapon.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Range of the Javelin increases via epoch quality, from 12 units at Epoch 1, to 16 units at Epoch 5.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Guaranteed Perk “Punishing Hit”: Enemies hit by the javelin have 20% less armor and movement speed for 8s.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Item Preview Screen[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We have added a preview screen which allows players to click on each Item (Military and Economy Equipment) to view them.[/p][/*][*][p]Available Screens:[/p][list][*][p]Shop (Items and Drafts).[/p][list][*][p]Storage (Drafts).[/p][/*][*][p]Epoch (Items, with level and rarity)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Improved Repositioning in the formation screen for a smoother experience.[/p][list][*][p]Dragging over the edges of the virtual yard on the battlefield will always use the closest valid position.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have corrected “Practical Armor”, It is now unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]The Splash Screen upon opening the game has been returned to the standard version.[/p][/*][*][p]We updated the Raid Preview screen to clarify that displayed rewards are potential rewards players may receive.[/p][/*][*][p]We have changed the hand indicator from a background circle to "L" for off-hand, and "R" for main hand. "LR" is shown for two-handed weapons.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508298/bd322f416c3a7fbf6b7726f3f10fcbc987f9f490.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Balancing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]We have Rebalanced Several Weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Aslaug Aura: Aslaug’s Aura now grants 15% Evasion and Critical Strike Chance, instead of 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Military Research: Balanced Diet: We have decreased the health bonus of Balanced Diet from 4/8/12/16/20% to 3/6/9/12/15% at their respective epochs.[/p][list][*][p]We have added +1 Troop Count for each of the following Weapons:[/p][list][*][p]Arming Sword.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Spear.[/p][/*][*][p]Club. (Bonk)[/p][/*][*][p]Falchion.[/p][/*][*][p]Horseman's Pick.[/p][/*][*][p]Mace.[/p][/*][*][p]Messer.[/p][/*][*][p]Morning Star.[/p][/*][*][p]Pernach.[/p][/*][*][p]Pike.[/p][/*][*][p]Saber.[/p][/*][*][p]Seax.[/p][/*][*][p]Shepherds Axe. (You know it)[/p][/*][*][p]Ulfberht Sword.[/p][/*][*][p]War Axe.[/p][/*][*][p]War Hammer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bludgeon: We have increased the attack speed of the Bludgeon from 24 to 26 attacks per a minute.[/p][/*][*][p]Doloire: We have decreased the attack speed of the Doloire from 41 to 39 attacks per minute.[/p][/*][*][p]Executioner Sword: Several changes have been made to this item.[/p][list][*][p]We have increased this items attack speed from 23 to 25 attacks per a minute.[/p][/*][*][p]We have increased this items weight from 11 to 12.[/p][/*][*][p]We have increased this items Critical Strike chance form 0% to 12%.[/p][/*][*][p]We have increased this items range from 1.2 to 1.4.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Falchion: We have decreased the Falchion’s attack speed from 36 to 35 attacks per minute.[/p][/*][*][p]Lucerne Hammer: We have increased the Lucerne Hammer’s attack speed from 24 to 25 attacks per minute.[/p][/*][*][p]Shepherds Axe: We have decreased the Shepherd Axe’s attack speed from 39 to 37 attacks per minute.[/p][/*][*][p]War Axe: We have decreased the War Axe’s attack speed from 40 to 38 attacks per minute.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixing[/b][/h1][list][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing unit health bars to remain the same when the unit received healing. This was visual only.[/p][/*][*][p]Units couldn’t be repositioned to the top and right borders during before the battle.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing the latency panel to show after logout and login even if the account has no permission.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing Military research to add +100% to army power if at least one node is researched.[/p][/*][*][p]Saladin’s Sandstorm wasn’t affecting enemies. We have also fixed the description to account for Ability Effect Duration, instead of only the ability duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Alfred, Barbarossa and Joan increase ability duration skill[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue where some weapons were affected by banner colors.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue allowing the Firecracker to deal too much burn damage.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue causing El Cid to trigger his ability even if there were no enemies in range.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue with the "First Purchase Bonus" banner for Ruby and Pearl displays not updating after being purchased.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue preventing players from entering the shop after exiting storage.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed an issue that caused infinite loading after an ad was interrupted.[/p][/*][/list]
